Share a microphone and system sound between two Windows PCs on your network — like Mouse Without Borders, but for audio. Plug one headset into one PC and use it for both.

## Get started

1. Download `{{SETUP}}` below on **both** PCs and run it. It installs for your account only (no admin rights) and keeps itself up to date: new releases are offered in the app. {{SIGNING_NOTE}}
   Prefer no install? `{{ZIP}}` holds the same single self-contained exe; unzip and run `VoiceWithoutBorders.exe`. No .NET install needed either way (64-bit Windows 10/11).
2. Start Voice Without Borders.
3. On each PC enter the other computer's name or IP and the same shared key, pick devices, press **Start** on both.
4. To use the other PC's microphone as a microphone on this PC, install the free [VB-CABLE](https://vb-audio.com/Cable/) here and choose **CABLE Output** under *Its microphone becomes*.

Full setup guide, a sample one-headset setup and troubleshooting are in the [README](https://github.com/Lunat1q/VoiceWithoutBorders#readme).
